preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 1 and 10,000.
The length of the graph adjacency list must equal the number of nodes n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(graph[i]) == len(set(graph[i])) for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each node's adjacency list must not contain duplicate edges.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of pairs of nodes at even distance from each other.
